item.title: Top 7 Ways to Solve the Need for zero_grad() in PyTorch
item.description:
Why is Calling zero_grad() Essential During Training in PyTorch?

When working on deep learning projects using PyTorch, you may wonder about the purpose of using zero_grad() in your training loops. This method is crucial in ensuring that gradients are calculated correctly and efficiently. Let’s delve into the reasons and methods behind calling zero_grad() and explore its significance in gradient management during the model training phase.

The Role of zero_grad()

Calling zero_grad(self) sets the gradients of all model parameters to zero. This is particularly important because PyTorch accumulates gradients by default. Hence, forgetting to reset the gradients could lead to incorrect calculations during optimization.
